subject: maths
topic_title: Mind the Mistake, Mend the Mistake
content:
We have expanded and simplified some algebraic expressions below to
their simplest forms.
(i)	 Check each of the simplifications and see if there is a mistake.
(ii)	 If there is a mistake, try to explain what could have gone
wrong.
(iii)	 Then write the correct expression.
6.4 This Way or That Way, All Ways Lead to the Bay
–3p (–5p + 2q)
= –3p + 5p – 2q
= p – 2q
2(x – 1) + 3 (x + 4)
= 2x – 1 + 3x + 4
= 5x + 3
y + 2 (y + 2)
= (y + 2)2
= y2 + 4y + 4
(5m + 6n)2
= 25m2 + 36n2
(– q + 2)2
= q2 – 4q + 4
3a (2b × 3c)
= 6ab × 9ac
= 54a2bc
2 (10s – 6) + 3
= 5s – 3 + 3
= 5s
5w2 + 6w
= 11w2
2a3 + 3a3 + 6a2b
+ 6ab2
= 5a3 + 12a2b2
(a + 2) (b + 4)
= ab + 8
ab2 + a2b + a2b2
= ab (a + b + ab)
(x + 2)(x + 5)
= (x + 2)x + (x + 2)5
= x2 + 2x + 5x +10
= x2 + 7x + 10
